positive_convergence_witness: x1>=r by exact nonnegative error; for n>=1, 0<=e[n+1]=e[n]^2/(2x[n])<=e[n]/2, so geometric bound proves convergence without simply assuming a limit
ring_verification: With S=sqrt(L²-a²)>|b|, x=a(S-b)/(2S),y=(b-S)/2; positive r1=L(S-b)/(2S),r2=L(S+b)/(2S) match both distance squares, sumL andstationarity
ring_global_bound: Triangle inequality for (x,-y)+(a-x,b-y) gives L>=sqrt(a²+(b-2y)²); thus y>=(b-S)/2; candidateattainsequality. Need teach inequality/warrant if baseline does not supply it.
physical_limit: static minimum/equilibrium model with light taut inextensible string, frictionless sliding ring and gravity; actual settling dynamics requires dissipation, not implied solely by force balance
